note: KBC's fee information document (1 January 2026): the Compte Base KBC, a package with a current account and a debit card, costs 2.50 euros a month (30 a year), free while a holder of a one- or two-holder account is under 25. Read again 2026-10-30: a direct debit refused for want of funds costs 6.05 EUR; an electronic SEPA transfer in euros nothing; withdrawals at KBC/CBC machines nothing, at another bank's 24 a month in the package then 0.50 EUR (written as free); in another currency at a foreign bank's machine 2.12 EUR plus 0.61%, plus the 1.94% exchange margin (written as 2.12 EUR plus 2.55%). The budget facility (an arranged overdraft) is 10.09% a year up to 1,250 EUR, granted on request, not written. Not stated: interest, the card's share on purchases in another currency, what opening asks.
